messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty P1 fired: inference-gateway error-rate spike in us-west1 — 5xx rate 4.9% over 5m. Trigger: error_rate_threshold (95th p50). Runbook: https://playbooks.redwood.ai/inference/error-spike

pagerduty: PagerDuty alert: PD-INC-799123 — page sent to #oncall (rotation)

oncall-alice: acked — I'm on it, taking lead.

ben-sre: quick check: kvcache eviction rate is high on model-pool-usw1, seeing a lot of short-lived KV misses + upstream 502s in the logs.

oncall-alice: looking at traces, requests show a burst of long context lengths and a batch size change 6m ago. correlates with 502s from model-worker nodes.

carla-frontend: telemetry shows a spike in client retries from mobile SDKs starting ~6:12 UTC, total failed requests ~0.6% of traffic but concentrated to a few customers. tagging customer teams.

dmitri-platform: can we shift traffic off us-west1 while we triage? I can adjust weights in the traffic router. prefer gradual to avoid shock.

oncall-alice: yes please — start at 10% -> 30% and pause. keep me posted.

dmitri-platform: executing gradual reroute: 10% moved to us-east1 now. command: `infractl traffic reroute --from=us-west1 --to=us-east1 --pct=10`

incident-bot: Recommended mitigations from runbook: 1) reroute traffic 2) warm KV cache 3) scale model-pool 4) rollback recent batching change.

ben-sre: pushing a quick cache warmup: `for k in $(cat hot_keys); do curl -s $CACHE/warm/$k; done` should reduce miss storm.

oncall-alice: applied warmup, rolled back the edge batching flag that landed ~6m ago (flag: batch-reorder).

carla-frontend: flag rollback done. removing new batching reduces per-request pressure on KV.

oncall-alice: observed 5xx rate drop to 2.1% in the last 2m after 10% reroute + warmup. continuing to push to 30% if stable.

dmitri-platform: increased reroute to 30% as requested. monitoring.

ben-sre: also noticed client retry loops amplifying traffic. suggest enabling short-circuit cache TTL to 5s for heavy endpoints to cut backend retries.

eve-support: starting incident update for customers: writing short note about degraded responses and active mitigation, will post to status.redwood.ai once you confirm impact text.

oncall-alice: confirm: customer impact limited — intermittent failed requests for a subset of users, best-effort retries hit backend hard. Please mention that we are rerouting and rolling back batching change.

eve-support: posting update now: status.redwood.ai/incidents/7991234567 — note: limited customer impact, mitigation in progress.

ben-sre: we also kicked an autoscale for model-pool-usw1 (+2 GPUs) as a fallback, ETA ~6m for nodes to register.

oncall-alice: good. if 5xx drops under 1% in next 10m we can stabilize and keep monitoring.

dmitri-platform: scale-up started, nodes coming up.

oncall-alice: update: 5xx down to 0.8% over last 3m after 30% reroute, cache warmup, and rollback. holding.

eve-support: sent customer update and alerted a few enterprise contacts directly (they reported increased errors).

carla-frontend: thanks, I'll follow up with telemetry owners to add a guardrail for sudden batching config flips.

oncall-alice: closing the page once stable for 20m. owners for follow-up postmortem: ben-sre (retry amplification), carla-frontend (bfc rollback and guardrail), dmitri-platform (traffic router safeguards).

pagerduty: PagerDuty: incident acknowledged by oncall-alice, status: investigating.

oncall-alice: thanks everyone — we'll file a short incident post with timeline and action items after the 20m cool-down. :thumbsup:
